name: Personal loan
shortDescription: Lend or borrow money with clear repayment terms.
description: Records the principal, repayment date, interest position, payment method and what happens if repayment is missed.

fields.label: Loan principal
fields.help: The amount being lent, in naira.

fields.label: Full repayment date
fields.help: The date the loan should be fully repaid.

fields.label: Interest
fields.placeholder: Interest-free
fields.help: State the interest rate, or write 'Interest-free'.

fields.label: Repayment schedule
fields.placeholder: ₦100,000 on 30 June and ₦200,000 on 31 July
fields.help: Optional. List instalments if repayment is not a single payment.

fields.label: Payment method
fields.placeholder: Bank transfer to the lender's account

fields.label: If repayment is missed
fields.placeholder: The borrower will be contacted and given 7 days to pay.
fields.help: Describe the practical next steps. This does not replace legal advice.

name: Sale of goods
shortDescription: Record the item, price, condition and delivery terms.
description: Useful for phones, electronics, furniture, vehicles and other goods where condition, deposit and delivery matter.

fields.label: Item description
fields.placeholder: iPhone 13, 128GB, blue
fields.help: Describe the item clearly, including model or identifying details.

fields.label: Deposit paid
fields.help: Leave blank if no deposit is paid.

fields.label: Delivery details
fields.placeholder: Handover at Ikeja on 20 June
fields.help: Where and how the item will be handed over.

fields.label: Inspection terms
fields.placeholder: Buyer may inspect the item before taking delivery.
fields.help: Explain when the buyer can inspect the item.

name: Service / freelance agreement
shortDescription: Put scope, deliverables, fees and deadlines in writing.
description: For freelancers, consultants and service providers who need a clear scope, milestones and payment dates.

fields.label: Scope of work
fields.placeholder: Design a 5-page marketing website
fields.help: Say exactly what work is included.

fields.label: Deliverables
fields.placeholder: Homepage, 4 inner pages, mobile layout
fields.help: List what the client will receive.

fields.label: Milestones and dates
fields.placeholder: Design draft by 20 June; final files by 5 July

fields.label: Revision limit
fields.placeholder: Two rounds of revisions

fields.label: Acceptance process
fields.placeholder: The client will confirm acceptance within 5 days of delivery.

name: Deposit and balance agreement
shortDescription: Record what a deposit covers and when the balance is due.
description: Useful when a buyer pays part of a price now and the balance later.

fields.label: Purpose of the deposit
fields.placeholder: Reservation of a plot of land
fields.help: Explain what the deposit is for.

fields.label: Cancellation terms
fields.placeholder: If the buyer cancels, the deposit is non-refundable.
fields.help: Say what happens if either side cancels.

fields.label: Refund terms
fields.placeholder: If the seller cannot complete the deal, the deposit is refunded in full.

name: Instalment payment agreement
shortDescription: Set out instalments, due dates and default consequences.
description: Records the total price, instalment amounts, payment dates and what happens when an instalment is late.

fields.label: If an instalment is late
fields.placeholder: A late fee of ₦5,000 applies after 7 days.
fields.help: Explain late-payment consequences. Keep it reasonable and lawful.

name: Supply / order agreement
shortDescription: Document quantities, prices, delivery and inspection.
description: For suppliers and buyers recording an order, delivery date, inspection and payment terms.

fields.label: Goods or services
fields.placeholder: 50 cartons of bottled water

fields.label: Quantity
fields.placeholder: 50 cartons

fields.label: Inspection terms
fields.placeholder: Buyer will inspect goods on delivery.

fields.label: Payment terms
fields.placeholder: 50% on order, 50% on delivery.

name: Rent / tenancy record
shortDescription: Record rent, deposit, term and tenancy obligations.
description: A practical record of the premises, rent, deposit and payment dates. It does not replace statutory tenancy formalities.

fields.label: Premises
fields.placeholder: 2-bedroom flat at 12 Adeola Street, Yaba, Lagos

fields.label: Tenancy term
fields.placeholder: 12 months, renewable by agreement

fields.label: Payment dates
fields.placeholder: Rent is paid annually in advance on 1 July.

fields.label: Obligations
fields.placeholder: Tenant maintains internal repairs; landlord maintains structure.

name: Vehicle sale record
shortDescription: Record vehicle details, price, defects and handover.
description: Documents a vehicle sale, disclosed defects, payment and handover. Registration and title transfer formalities are separate.

fields.label: Vehicle details
fields.placeholder: Toyota Corolla 2015, chassis JTDBR32E..., registration LSD-123-AB

fields.label: Payment terms
fields.placeholder: Full payment by bank transfer on handover.

fields.label: Disclosed defects
fields.placeholder: Small dent on rear bumper; air conditioning needs servicing.

fields.label: Documents handed over
fields.placeholder: Vehicle licence, proof of ownership, receipt

name: Acknowledgement of debt
shortDescription: Record an amount owed and the repayment terms.
description: Confirms that a person owes a stated amount and how they intend to repay it.

fields.label: Reason for the debt
fields.placeholder: Unpaid balance for goods supplied in March.

fields.label: Repayment terms
fields.placeholder: ₦100,000 monthly for three months.

name: General agreement
shortDescription: A flexible starting point for other everyday agreements.
description: Use for a straightforward transaction that does not fit the other templates. Custom terms may need legal review.

fields.label: Subject of the agreement
fields.placeholder: Sale of a set of office chairs

fields.label: Obligations of each party
fields.placeholder: Seller delivers the chairs; buyer pays on delivery.

fields.label: Additional terms
fields.help: Custom terms may need legal review.
